Ishan Kishan, Abhishek Sharma Set New T20 Boundary Records

Ishan Kishan has set a new record for the most boundaries hit in a calendar year in T20 cricket, with Abhishek Sharma ranking third. Both players are among the top five batters to achieve this feat. Separately, Shreyas Iyer became the first Indian captain to lose a specific number of T20I matches within a year, surpassing Rohit Sharma in a 'SENA' club.
